page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.24xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on the x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM virtualization. The machine is powered by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor operating at 2.25 GHz, supplying 96 dedicated vCPUs. System memory totals 384.0 GB, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU without hardware-level resource overcommitment.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 50 Gbps, enabling rapid inter-node communication for distributed architectures. The server does not include local disk storage, requiring external network-attached storage volumes for all operating system and persistent data requirements. The instance operates without GPU accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By offering 96 physical compute execution threads alongside high memory density and broad networking throughput, the ecs.g9ae.24xlarge provides robust resource density for non-accelerated computing. It is suited for large-scale enterprise application hosting, batch ETL processing, container orchestration nodes, and distributed web serving deployments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.24xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance powered by the AMD EPYC 9T95 processor on the x86_64 architecture under KVM virtualization. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs operating at a 2.25 GHz clock speed, combined with 384.0 GB of system memory to achieve a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server includes 50 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, supporting high-throughput inter-node data exchange. It does not bundle local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for operational storage, and includes zero hardware GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With high core density and broad memory allocation, the ecs.g9ae.24xlarge is configured for large enterprise applications, scalable web serving, continuous integration clusters, microservices hosts, and distributed ETL workloads requiring dedicated compute resources and substantial networking bandwidth.
